title: LiquidityPool
description: Detailed schema representing a Liquidity Pool within the financial ecosystem. This schema enforces strict validation for monetary precision (4 decimal places) and integrates C03 safety clamp protocols to manage risk and volatility limits.

poolId.description: Unique immutable identifier for the liquidity pool.

name.description: Human-readable name of the liquidity pool.

assetPair.description: The asset pair managed by this pool.

baseAsset.description: The base asset symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH).

quoteAsset.description: The quote asset symbol (e.g., USDC, USDT).

totalValueLocked.description: The total value of assets currently locked in the pool. Validated to 4 decimal places.

availableLiquidity.description: The portion of liquidity available for immediate trading or lending. Validated to 4 decimal places.

reservedLiquidity.description: Liquidity reserved for pending transactions or safety margins. Validated to 4 decimal places.

precision.description: The fixed decimal precision for this pool's values.

c03SafetyClamp.description: Configuration and status of the C03 safety clamp protocol, designed to halt operations during extreme volatility or anomaly detection.

isEnabled.description: Indicates if the C03 safety protocols are currently active on this pool.

upperBoundLimit.description: The maximum allowable value for single transactions defined by C03.

lowerBoundLimit.description: The minimum allowable value for single transactions defined by C03.

volatilityThreshold.description: Percentage change within 1 hour that triggers a clamp.

currentClampState.description: Current operational state regarding the safety clamp.

fees.description: Fee structure for the liquidity pool.

swapFeeRate.description: Fee rate charged on swaps (decimal representation, e.g., 0.003 for 0.3%).

status.description: The lifecycle status of the liquidity pool.

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the last state change.
